articles.title: Burnham proposes NHS-style social care system for England
articles.description: The prime minister told the BBC that social care in England is "as unfair as American healthcare".

articles.title: Orange Order march row goes to heart of ongoing divisions in Northern Ireland
articles.description: The dispute over the controversial parade is a reminder that the peace process is not over.

articles.title: Ten NHS staff removed over Noah Woods data breach
articles.description: East Suffolk and North Essex NHS Foundation Trust says it has launched an "urgent" investigation.

articles.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
articles.description: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.
